summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of a Nasdaq extension to March 1, 2027 for regaining compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule. The company previously received a deficiency notice on March 2, 2026. To cure, it must maintain a closing bid of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, possibly up to 20. CEO Brittany Kaiser stated intent to use all tools including a reverse share split. The stock continues trading under ALP. Monitor compliance progress and potential reverse split announcement.
